messages.content: 今天北京的日落時間是什麼時候？

function.name: calculate_sunrise
function.description: Calculate the time of sunrise for a specific date and location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location for which sunrise time needs to be calculated.

date.description: The date for which sunrise time needs to be calculated in YYYY-MM-DD format. If not provided, current date is considered. Default: 1998-12-03

format.description: Format in which the time should be returned. If not provided, default format 'HH:MM' is considered.

message.content: I’m sorry, but the function I have access to can only calculate sunrise times. If you’d like to know the sunrise time for Beijing today, I can provide that. Let me know!

We can compute sunrise and then approximate sunset? But better to respond that we can't compute sunset with given function. We can ask for clarification or provide sunrise. But user asked sunset. We can say we can only calculate sunrise. Or we can approximate sunset by using sunrise function? But no. So we should respond that we can only calculate sunrise. Ask if they want sunrise.
